text: MessageList options now carry messagesPerPage and includeDeletedMessages, with nullish defaults at construction. Event callers set the inclusion flag while other list callers retain the default. Follow this local named-options shape when adding independent list policies, so page size and deletion visibility do not become ambiguous positional values. This is a scoped recommendation from current code, not an approved project-wide syntax rule. Static source and test inspection only. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator discussion is pending.
title: Grow MessageList options as named fields with explicit defaults
